scope: Concrete poetry proper (Gomringer, 1953; the Noigandres group, 1952; Finlay; Garnier) is in copyright and is not seated. What is seated is its line: the late-antique grid poem, Mallarmé's spatial page and Apollinaire's figured verse, with the Futurist parole in libertà (Marinetti's Zang Tumb Tuuum, Govoni's Rarefazioni) in card 18/03 and Morgenstern's typographic poems in 18/07. The Hellenistic technopaegnia (Simmias, Theocritus's Syrinx) are in the theocritus seat and the Greek Anthology. Rabanus Maurus's In honorem sanctae crucis and George Herbert's 'Easter Wings' were not located in this pass; QUEUED.

why_seated: The concrete poets, as far back as the public domain reaches. A poem whose layout is part of its meaning cannot be seated as running text alone, so this seat carries the scans.
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-15: "we need more seatings of avant garde literature. dada. farce. oulipo. futurist. - whatevers in the public domain. originals is good on classics, impoverished on modern. and i want the italian troubadors. and pound, more pound. need the cantos." — "and the concrete poets" — "also need jarry, schlovsky, etc" — "it gets an ea-corpora deposit and a spine and a card on tll, bulk seatings per ea-corpora deposit is fine".
